zones.title: Show Flexom Zones
zones.description: Flexom Zones (i.e. rooms) will appear as devices with light and rolling shutter controls.

tolerance.title: Factor value tolerance
tolerance.description: How far (ratio between 0 and 1) a window covering can stop from its target and still be considered there, as Flexom devices do not always reach the exact requested value (e.g. 0.01 instead of 0 when closed). HomeKit then shows the requested position. Also used to ignore small position jitter.

refreshInterval.title: State refresh interval (minutes)
refreshInterval.description: How often to fetch every zone's state from Flexom, to fix HomeKit when a change was missed (e.g. a light switched on with a wall switch but not reported). Zones are refreshed one at a time across the interval. Set to 0 to disable.

id.placeholder: See accessory serial number in Home app
